questions.q: Name Ryff's six dimensions of psychological well-being.
questions.a: Self-acceptance, positive relations with others, autonomy, environmental mastery, purpose in life and personal growth.

questions.q: What did Lucas (2007) conclude about adaptation?
questions.a: Adaptation is real but incomplete, and people differ in how much they adapt.

questions.q: Why is the brain-chemistry explanation of the two kinds of happiness not relied on?
questions.a: The mechanisms are simplifications and a genomic result was disputed on statistical grounds.
